messages:
sasha: heads-up — the new stacked comparison zoom on the eval console is showing empty buckets when you zoom into the nested breakdowns (intent -> token_length). no errors in browser console, just blank rows.

maria: can repro locally, happens once you enable the quantized variant filter. looks like some cohorts drop out after grouping. i'll dig in.

ben: @maria repro steps? i tried baseline vs quant-q4 and i get counts but the stacked panes render blank sparklines for some cohorts.

maria: repro steps i used:
1) open /console/scorecards
2) model=redwood-3b-quant
3) breakdown by label.intent then token_length_bucket
4) click stacked compare -> zoom into bucket 'payment_info'
observed: empty table + exporter 500 on CI

eval-bot: eval-runner v2.14 completed run 2023-11-03T12:41:02Z; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/2023/11/03/2319; export manifest size=0

ben: sounds like exporter filtered out quant variants during ingest. maybe a variant_id vs variant_alias mismatch in the ingest job.

sasha: also worth noting: the sidebar metric shows Weighted-Kappa baseline=0.78 quant=0.82, but per-cohort kappa jumps to 1.0 after zoom — that smells like an aggregation bug rather than real improvement.

maria: quick find: frontend merges cohort keys using `sample_group`, backend writes `cohort_id`. small mismatch in the fetchLayer caused rows to be dropped when both breakdowns are present.

ben: ah — nice catch. also the legend colors reset between compare panes so baseline and quant sometimes use same blue. makes visual diff useless.

sasha: can we add a unit test in viz-renderer to assert legend color consistency across panes? cheap guardrail.

maria: opened PR #4582 with the fetchLayer fix + e2e for nested breakdowns + legend palette guard. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4582

console-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2319876600 for PR 4582

sasha: sweet. follow-up: add a CI check to fail exports when manifest_size==0 or sample_count mismatch — it's silently wasting CI cycles.

ben: filing ticket WEB-1293 for CI export guard. also attaching the minimal query we used for local repro:
```
SELECT cohort_id, token_length_bucket, COUNT(1) as cnt
FROM eval_samples
WHERE model_tag='redwood-3b-quant'
GROUP BY 1,2
```

maria: verified on staging after deploy, counts restored and stacked compare works. marking resolved for now and will monitor telemetry for 24h.

eval-bot: monitor note: regression-checker scheduled for next run in ~2h
